prerequisites: Prior knowledge of fundamentals of mathematics and physics is recommended.
syllabus_topics: Velocity and acceleration in non-inertial systems. Movement of a system of particles
Kinematics of rigid bodies: application to basic mechanisms
Velocity field of a rigid body
Acceleration field of a rigid body
Dynamics of rigid bodies: application to basic mechanisms
Basic elements of mechanisms. Degrees of freedom. Grübler's criterion
teaching_methods: Experimental and computer lab practical classes
assessment_rules: The general assessment model is continuous assessment. A minimum of 4 out of 10 must be achieved in both the final written theoretical-practical exam (70%) and the laboratory and computer practicals (30%). The overall weighted average must be 5 or higher; failure to meet a minimum grade in an activity results in that activity's score being the final grade. Students who fail or do not attend the ordinary call can retake only the failed reassessable activities in the extraordinary call.
bibliography: Beer- Johnston. Mecánica vectorial para ingenieros. Estática y Dinâmica. McGraw Hill.
